entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Telephone sets, including smartphones and other telephones for cellular networks or for other wireless networks; other apparatus for the transmission or reception of voice, images or other data, including apparatus for communication in a wired or wireless network (such as a local or wide area network), other than transmission or reception apparatus of heading 8443, 8525, 8527 or 8528
entries.comment:
This reduced rate applies only to aids for the deaf, blind and visually impaired persons (part 4): 
navigation equipment, including compasses and other orienteering aids with sound output; 9014 80 00, 9014 10 00, 8526
— alarm systems with light or vibration output for the deaf (telephone, baby`s crying, doorbell, smoke alarm and other such); 8517, 8531 10 30, 8531 10 95
